milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when oak_planks blocks are mined, they drop as items that enter the player's inventory. The player starts with only a wooden_axe and no oak_planks, so any oak_planks in inventory must have been mined from the oak plank hut structure at spawn-relative positions ~4-8, ~1-3, ~5-9. Per-step checking ensures this milestone triggers the moment planks enter inventory, even if they are later consumed during stick crafting.

Uses inventory_has because crafted sticks end up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no sticks and the only way to obtain sticks in this scene is by crafting them from mined oak_planks (2 planks → 4 sticks, using either the 2×2 inventory grid or the crafting table at ~2, ~1, ~3). No false-positive risk since no other stick source exists in the scene.
